meanings.note: Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'attention' in everyday Russian.

meanings.en: to guess, to work out, to think of
meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'гадаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'guessed, figured out', paired with 'догадываться'.
